subject: Game Theory
title: Outside Options
description: Learn Outside Options in one minute.

hook.text: Before negotiating your salary, you get a competing job offer. Suddenly your employer becomes generous.

buildup.text: Outside options shift bargaining power. The side with better alternatives can credibly threaten to walk away.

discovery.text: In game theory, an outside option raises your disagreement payoff—changing what you'll accept.

twist.text: Even a bluffed outside option can work—if the other side can't verify it. But getting caught destroys trust.

climax.text: Countries negotiate trade deals this way: 'Accept our terms, or we'll sign with your rival instead.'

punchline.text: Options are leverage. Create them first.

quiz.question: How do outside options affect bargaining?
options: They increase the power of the side with better alternatives
